text: Uzcard speaks JSON-RPC, and Humo speaks SOAP, with different fields and different errors.
prefix: Uzcard speaks JSON-RPC, and Humo speaks SOAP, with different fields and different errors.

text: If the payment code knew both, every new scheme would mean touching payment code.

text: So the card module defines one port, a card processor: bind a card, debit, reverse, and status.

text: Each scheme gets its own adapter behind that port.
prefix: Each scheme gets its own adapter behind that port.

text: Uzcard debits in one step, by the card's token, with our payment id as the external reference.
prefix: Uzcard debits in one step, by the card's token, with our payment id as the external reference.

text: Humo holds the money first, then captures the hold right away.

text: Every answer becomes one of three outcomes: approved, declined with our own code, or unknown.

text: A timeout is unknown and never a decline, because the money may already have moved.
